title: Numbered Steps
style: A listicle reel: giant numerals (1, 2, 3) fill the frame on a solid colour field, each step's words stack beside the numeral, and a small illustrated icon scene demonstrates it. The numeral morphs from one to the next. Bold, flat, poster-like. Captions are serif word ladders (kit captions.ts): short stacks of mixed sizes, one key word in the accent italic, set beside the action and arriving word by word.
learnsFrom: Founder explainer reels (Instagram, @gregisenberg's team): giant step numerals with the words stacked beside them, a numbered card (1-2-3) summary, a call to action at the end.

story.what: hook: '3 steps to a calmer week' in a ladder; three dots count 1-2-3
a giant '1' slams in; beside it 'Block your deep work'; an icon of a calendar gets three blue blocks
the 1 morphs into a '2'; 'Batch your meetings'; scattered meeting chips gather into one afternoon
the 2 morphs into a '3'; 'Let the calendar ask'; a chat bubble 'find an hour' turns into a booked chip
summary card lists 1-2-3 with ticks; CTA: 'Comment "calm" for the checklist'; 'Oriel' small underneath

sizes: Square puts the numeral left and the words right at a smaller size.
sound: beatScore drive at 120 bpm with a hit on each numeral slam, ticks on icon moves and the sign-off under the CTA.
teaches: A listicle's structure is its animation: the numeral is the transition, so every step feels like one more beat of the same idea.

portable.fonts: Instrument Serif and Instrument Serif Italic for captions, Inter for labels
